dimensions.name: Quality gates
dimensions.recommendation: Add launch gates with explicit thresholds and blocking severity.

dimensions.name: Observability
dimensions.recommendation: Define monitoring dashboard, traces, alerts, and feedback capture.

dimensions.name: Operational readiness
dimensions.recommendation: Add support runbook, handoff flow, documentation, and training plan.

dimensions.name: Rollback and rollout
dimensions.recommendation: Define phased rollout, rollback, fallback, and kill switch plan.

dimensions.name: Risk and safety
dimensions.recommendation: Add risk review, privacy/security checks, guardrails, and incident process.

dimensions.name: Business readiness
dimensions.recommendation: Tie launch to business/product metrics and stakeholder alignment.
